title: Area-code shard C pass 23 — 641 / 650 / 656
summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public-person enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 641, 650, and 656.

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 641, 650, and 656?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived public web searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public-person role enumeration, and explicit uncertainty handling.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, residence, or public role.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For overlay NPAs, locality association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: North Iowa Community Action Organization and Hawkeye Harvest Food Bank are current Mason City/North Central Iowa organizations. NICAO directly publishes a 641 phone number. Current first-party leadership names Cindy D. as CEO; the abbreviated surname remains source-scoped and is not merged with historical Cindy Davis references.

South Bay Mutual Aid has an explicit Lower Peninsula/San Mateo County service footprint and ongoing Free Store/community-garden programs. Ecumenical Hunger Program is current in East Palo Alto and directly publishes a 650 contact number. Lesia Preston and LaKesha Roberts have directly stated first-party leadership roles.

Tampa Food Not Bombs is current with 2026 activity and public email/Instagram and is retained as anarchist-associated Food Not Bombs. Tampa Autonomous Tenants Union is current by public Linktree plus March 2026 organizing corroboration; its name/self-description is preserved without upgrading it to anarchist. NPA 656 overlays 813, so both 656 relations are geographic only and assert no 656 phone ownership.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-person enumeration pass
